subject: Implementation runway & MAP: ownership slate + readiness checklist
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nadia Patel <nadia.patel@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Implementation runway & MAP: ownership slate + readiness checklist

Thanks, Jonas — good conversation today. Nadia and I chatted and wanted to confirm a few things before we lock dates:

- Our internal approval window for the SOW is the week of Jun 20 (legal + procurement).
- We need production-simulated throughput tests before the pilot go-live (target week of Jul 22).
- Security has asked for a short SOC 2 scoping checklist; happy to accept Redwood's template.

I've attached a worksheet with the dates we discussed. Can you send a one-page MAP that names owners for each milestone so we can route approvals internally?

Appreciate the focus on cutover windows — we prefer week-night low-traffic slots.

Best,
Liam
Director of Platform Engineering
Arcadia Health

Attachment: capacity-notes.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 Jun 2028 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Implementation runway & MAP: ownership slate + readiness checklist

Liam — thanks for the rapid follow-up and the worksheet. Per your ask, I've drafted an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that assigns owners, target dates, and acceptance criteria. Key highlights below; full MAP attached as Arcadia_MAP_v1.xlsx.

High-level milestones (first pass):
- 2028-06-10: SOW draft circulated (owner: Marissa Cole / Redwood)
- 2028-06-21: SOW sign-off window opens (owner: Liam / Arcadia)
- 2028-07-08: Security scoping & evidence exchange (owner: Soojin Lee / Redwood; Arcadia security point: Nadia)
- 2028-07-22: Performance sim tests (owner: Redwood infra)
- 2028-08-01: Pilot go-live (owner: Arcadia project lead)

Open items we flagged:
1) Exact KPI targets for token throughput during pilot — Liam, can you confirm target RPS and token/sec so Soojin can size the test nodes?
2) Preferred maintenance blackout windows (weeknights vs weekends).
3) Any dependency on a cloud marketplace procurement flow (will affect procurement SLA).

Next steps:
- Marissa will circulate the SOW draft by EOD Friday (Jun 7).
- Soojin will share our SOC 2 scoping template and a short evidence list by Jun 9.
- I'll set a 30-minute alignment call for Wed Jun 6 to walk the MAP and questions.

Thanks — attaching the MAP and a short SOW stub.

Jonas Weber
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0131

Attachments: Arcadia_MAP_v1.xlsx; Draft_SOW_Arcadia_06-07.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 4 Jun 2028 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation runway & MAP: ownership slate + readiness checklist

Liam — attaching the SOW draft as promised. A couple of notes on sequencing:

- The SOW includes a 2-week procurement buffer after sign-off to secure dedicated capacity; if Arcadia wants to accelerate, we can prioritize reserved pool allocation but that requires a PO and quicker signatures.
- Implementation sprint plan in the appendix has a two-week sprint cadence; each sprint includes acceptance criteria and a short rollback plan.

Concrete asks for Arcadia before the security call on Jul 8:
- Provide RPS/token targets for pilot (one-liner is fine)
- Point of contact for change windows and a preferred weekly maintenance window (we prefer Tue/Wed nights; we'll mirror your preference)

If everything looks good I'll update the MAP owners page (right now owners are gray-boxed where we need confirmation).

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — reviewed the SOW draft and the MAP spreadsheet. A few edits from our side:

- Please change the procurement buffer to 14 business days in the SOW (legal requirement).
- We need a line item to confirm data retention and encryption at rest details (SOC / legal ask).
- Pilot KPI target: 150 QPS sustained for 10 minutes (token size average ~60 tokens). We may run 3 back-to-back simulations.

We can confirm sign-off window (week of Jun 20) but will try to accelerate the legal review. Can someone from Redwood provide a short note on fallback behavior if capacity constraints occur during the pilot? That'll help legal and ops align.

Nadia
Head of Procurement, Arcadia Health

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Patel <nadia.patel@arcadiahealth.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation runway & MAP: ownership slate + readiness checklist

Nadia / Liam — thanks for the KPI and the procurement note. Quick answers to your open items below: 

- RPS / capacity sizing: 150 QPS sustained with 60-token average => recommendation: 4 medium inference nodes (reserved), 1 warm spare for failover during pilot. We'll provide exact perf test config when we schedule the sim runs.
- Fallback behavior: if dedicated capacity is constrained Redwood will first route to a compatible quantized variant in the same region (pre-agreed fallback). If that is unavailable, we will escalate to our cross-region fallback policy and notify Arcadia with an automatic incident ticket. All fallback rules will be captured in the MAP's 'Degradation & Escalation' tab.
- SOC 2 scoping: attaching the short evidence list and a one-page summary of encryption-at-rest and key management.

Proposed next steps:
1) I'll schedule the security scoping call for Tue Jul 8, 09:00 PT — please confirm your attendees.
2) Marissa to update SOW with the 14-business-day procurement buffer and the data-retention clauses (target: Jun 9 update).
3) Jonas to push updated MAP to the shared Drive and send a calendar invite for the Jun 6 alignment call (if you still want it; otherwise we can collapse into the security scoping).

Sooj
Head of Reliability & Solutions, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
